events.title: Quantum’s Risks Are Overstated—and the Investment Opportunity May Be Underestimated
events.body: Barclays says quantum computing demand could reach $100 billion by 2040, with companies like IonQ, IBM, and Nvidia positioned across the value chain.

events.title: Quantum Computing Stocks: IonQ Kicks Off Earnings Reports Amid Acquisition Spree
events.body: IonQ kicks off first quarter earnings reports for quantum computing stocks on Wednesday amid its acquisition spree.

events.title: Here’s What the Street Thinks About D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) Ahead of FQ1 2026 Earnings
events.body: ​D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NYSE:QBTS) is set to release its FQ1 2026 earnings on May 12. Wall Street expects the company to post around $4.14 million in quarterly revenue along with a GAAP EPS of negative $0.10. Analysts are bullish on the stock
